searched.title: Vortek Utility Hotends Bundle (store page)
searched.note: Parsed with the package (extractPage + buildImportPayload, format legacy_html, productType "hotend"); the corpus copy, offline. Product Specifications (one 4-cell table): "Max. Printing Temp. | 350 ℃ | Length | 56.2 mm", "Packaging Weight | 0.095 kg | Packaging Size | 135*100*45 mm"; no width, height, net weight, flow or electrical value. In the Box: 3 lines (4 hotends). Description bullets give each hotend's size, side and material. "Filament Compatibility": 43 filaments × 7 induction nozzle columns; only the 0.2 mm Stainless Steel, 0.4 mm Hardened Steel and 0.6 mm Hardened Steel columns match this bundle; a matrix stays text (§C.6), and relations are written only for the 12 filaments marked √ in all three and Compatible in the wiki table. Not written: PC and PC FR (page √ at 0.2 mm, wiki PC row "Not Recommended" at 0.2 mm); TPU 85A (page X in every column, but the page's own note 4 says "TPU85A is only supported on the right-side Fixed Hotend" and the wiki says 0.4/0.6 mm Compatible); PET-CF, PPA-CF, PPS-CF (page √ for induction 0.4/0.6 mm, but note 5 says "supported only on the left-side Liftable Hotend"); every filament with a mixed, X or "Not recommended" cell among the three sizes (the single bundle value cannot carry a per-hotend relation). Nozzle diameters are three (0.2/0.4/0.6 mm), which the single-number nozzle.diameter cannot hold; they stay in the Size value text and the In the Box list. Marketing sentences ("up to 7 filaments", "up to 24 materials") prove no number; not stored.

searched.title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: Read in full from the cached HTML (the cached .txt omits the tab panels). Vortek Induction Nozzle panel: "Compatibility: H2C (right hotend) | Max. Printing Temp: 350 ℃ | Size: 0.2mm/ 0.4mm/ 0.6mm/ 0.8mm | Materials: Hardened steel / Stainless steel"; H2 Series/P2S/X2D Nozzle panel: "H2C (left hotend) | Max. Printing Temp: 350 ℃". Both name their own purchase links, not this bundle; they agree with the store page (350 ℃; sizes and materials). The "about 8 seconds to reach printing temperature (e.g., 220°C)" sentence has no registry key and is a claim, not a spec row; not stored. The layer-height table is general guidance per nozzle size, and this bundle mixes three sizes; not stored. No dimensions, weight, flow or electrical value.

searched.title: Introduction to the Workflow of the Vortek Induction Hotend | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: How the Vortek induction hotend works (coil, U-shaped steel sleeve, NTC, in-position magnet; contactless heating and data link). It states no maximum temperature, flow, power, dimensions or weight. Its description of the hotend as a swappable module with a contactless temperature and filament-data link is written as part.feature (unverified, prose). "Only about 8 seconds to reach printing temperature (e.g., 220°C)" has no registry key and is a claim; not stored.

specs.note: Agrees with the deterministic row (350 ℃, verified, official_page); same rank, so the merge keeps the page row. Both wiki nozzle panels for the two hotend types in this bundle state the same maximum: the Vortek Induction Nozzle panel ("Compatibility: H2C (right hotend) | Max. Printing Temp: 350 ℃") and the H2 Series/P2S/X2D Nozzle panel ("Compatibility: H2D (both left and right), H2S, H2C (left hotend), P2S, X2D | Max. Printing Temp: 350 ℃"). Those panels name the component products (H2C Induction Hotend; Bambu Hotend - H2/P2S), not this bundle, so they are corroboration only. In range (150–350 °C).

Agrees with the deterministic row (56.2 mm). The page does not say which of the bundle's two hotend types (induction RHS or standard LHS) this length measures; kept as the page states it. No width or height is published (see not_published).

The registry stores grams: 0.095 kg = 95 g; the merge writes the text as published ("0.095 kg"). Agrees with the deterministic row (value_num 95). A packaging (logistics) measure (§B.7), never products.package_* or net_weight_g.
First of the three published packaging dimensions (L*W*H as written). Agrees with the deterministic row.
Second of the three published packaging dimensions. Agrees with the deterministic row.

specs.quote: In the Box - 0.4mm Induction Hotend (RHS) *2 - 0.2mm Hotend (LHS) *1 - 0.6mm Hotend (LHS) *1
specs.note: The official In the Box list writes every quantity: "0.4mm Induction Hotend (RHS) *2", "0.2mm Hotend (LHS) *1", "0.6mm Hotend (LHS) *1"; 2 + 1 + 1 = 4 hotends. The page never prints the total, so the count is a sum of the list's quantities, not a published number, and stays unverified (as in hotends-combo-h2-series). The Size value ("0.2mm LHS + 0.6mm LHS + 0.4mm*2 RHS") and the description bullets (×2, ×1, ×1) give the same count. In range (1–100).

specs.locator: Option group "Printer Model" › value 1 (the only value) … Compatibility section
specs.note: Conflict with the parsed store page: the deterministic row for this key holds the whole compatibility block (the wiki link sentence, the six numbered H2C usage notes and "H2C"; unverified, official_page). The printer the page names is H2C, in the option group and under its own "Compatibility" heading. This row (official_variant) outranks the page row at merge, and mergeCurated records the disagreement (spec_sources_disagree). The wiki places the parts: the induction hotends fit the H2C right hotend ("Compatibility: H2C (right hotend)"), the standard H2 Series hotends the H2C left hotend ("H2C (left hotend)"), which matches the page's RHS/LHS labels.
specs.conflict: The deterministic compat.statement row carries the full compatibility block text, not the printer; replaced by "H2C".

specs.value: Vortek induction hotend (the bundle's two 0.4 mm RHS induction hotends): a swappable independent module heated by induction from the toolhead; hotend temperature and filament information are transmitted without contact
specs.source_title: Introduction to the Workflow of the Vortek Induction Hotend
specs.locator: System Structure and Workflow › Vortek Induction Hotend: The Swappable Receiving End › intro sentence; bullet "Induction Communication Board"
specs.quote: The Vortek induction hotend is a swappable independent module … Transmits information (including hotend temperature data and printed filament information) … in a non-contact manner
specs.note: Added at adjudication (the second extraction had it; the cached page states it). The heating is the toolhead's: "The induction heating assembly is a fixed part of the toolhead". Applies to the bundle's two "0.4mm Induction Hotend (RHS)" only; the 0.2 mm and 0.6 mm LHS hotends are standard hotends (the store page: "matched combo of standard and induction hotends"). A paraphrase of manual prose, so unverified (§C.6: a value from prose stays unverified), as in the other curated part.feature rows. The page's "about 8 seconds to reach printing temperature" is a Core Advantages claim; not stored.

notes: Adjudicated against an independent second extraction (129 fields compared, 82 disagreements). Same fact, different form (16: locator wording, the nozzle.material value text, the part.feature wording, the H2C relation scope, the in-the-box block form): the first file's form kept. The H2C relation stays scoped to the only Printer Model value (667219482704769025) with target_source_handle "h2c" (compat-targets.json "H2C"), as the deterministic parse writes its option-value relation; the parse also writes the product-scope compat_section relation the second file has, so nothing is lost.

Present in the first file only, checked against the cached store page and kept: contents.pieces 4 (In the Box *2 + *1 + *1) and the 12 material relations (√ in all seven Induction columns of the page's Filament Compatibility table, so in the 0.2 mm Stainless Steel, 0.4 mm and 0.6 mm Hardened Steel columns; Compatible at 0.2, 0.4 and 0.6 mm in the wiki nozzle table for the standard LHS hotends; no numbered note restricts them). Matrix tables stay text plus curated relations (§C.6, hotends). Corrected: contents.pieces is verified → unverified, because the page prints no total (the 4 is a sum of the list's quantities).

Different values: part.feature status (the second file: verified). Kept unverified: the value paraphrases the wiki workflow page's prose (§C.6: a value from prose stays unverified). part.feature itself was added from the second extraction after checking the cached wiki page. nozzle.diameter is published as three sizes, which the single-number key cannot hold; it is neither written nor listed as not_published.
